name: FLIR ONE Pro
key_features: Thermal camera attachment; MSX imaging; Professional app
strengths: Brand recognition; Accurate imaging; Pro-grade features
weaknesses: Expensive ($200-400); Requires attachment; Steep learning curve

name: Seek Thermal
key_features: Smartphone thermal camera; Multiple models; App included
strengths: Lower price than FLIR; Good resolution; Easy to use
weaknesses: Still requires hardware purchase; Limited analysis features; No guidance

name: Home Energy Saver (DOE)
key_features: Free audit tool; Recommendations; Utility integration
weaknesses: Not visual/thermal; Requires manual data entry; Generic advice

name: Energy Star Home Advisor
key_features: DIY assessment; Improvement calculator; Rebate finder
weaknesses: No thermal imaging; Manual inspection; Basic

name: Local Energy Auditors
key_features: Professional assessment; Blower door test; Detailed report
strengths: Thorough; Expert interpretation; Sometimes required for rebates

name: Sense Home Energy Monitor
key_features: Electrical monitoring; Real-time tracking; Device detection
strengths: Continuous monitoring; Good UX; Smart home integration
weaknesses: Different approach (electrical vs thermal); Installation required; Higher cost

name: Emporia Vue
key_features: Circuit-level monitoring; Low cost; Real-time app
weaknesses: Limited to electrical; No thermal/leak detection; Requires some DIY
